question: In which year was Communist Party of India formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1925**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Communist Party of India(CPI)** was formed in **Kanpur on 26 December 1925**.
 
• S. V. Ghate was the **first Secretary of CPI**.
 
• The **main participants who contributed **to the formation of the party were **workers, students, peasants and intellectuals**.</l
